import re
import unicodedata

def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    ascii_only = ''.join(c for c in normalized if ord(c) < 128)
    lowercased = ascii_only.lower()
    hyphenated = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', lowercased)
    stripped = hyphenated.strip('-')
    if len(stripped) > 50:
        stripped = stripped[:50].rstrip('-')
    return stripped if stripped else "untitled"
